The '''Black Sun Headquarters''' was a building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] located in the [[Lower Gangland]] area of the [[Black Sun territory]]. It was the location of the headquarters of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. In [[3643 BBY]], the headquarters was the site of a [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|raid]] by [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Special tactical unit]] under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nidaljo]] and a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]].
